title: Triple Pairing
description:
Dive into a three-way romance in Triple Pairing, the love triangle VN now available on Steam!When you're caught between an elite young lady sent by fate, a childhood friend with a complicated history, and a motherly poster girl working at the local diner, who will you end up choosing?

Step into the shoes of a protagonist caught in a romantic crossfire, navigating one chaotic showdown after another in a youthful story woven with sweet moments and agonizing dilemmas

With the unique "Love Triangle" and "Radar Chart" systems, you personally tip the scales of the girls' affection.

Choose your destined partner, compose your own romantic waltz, and take the floor!
description_short: The three-way romance VN "Triple Pairing" now available on Steam! You are caught between an elite lady, a complicated childhood friend, and a motherly poster girl. Who will you choose? Navigate sweet moments and chaotic showdowns. Use the Love Triangle and Radar Chart systems to find your true love!
